with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) as t:
    path = t.name

    with MeteredFile(open(path, "r+b")) as f:

        f.seek(0)
        data = f.read()

    with MeteredFile(open(path, "r+b")) as f:
        lines = list(f)
    assert lines == [b"hello world"], lines
    assert (f.read_ops, f.read_bytes) == (1, 11)
finally:
    os.unlink(path)

# Real socketpair
a, b = socket.socketpair()
with MeteredSocket(a) as sa, MeteredSocket(b) as sb:
    sa.send(b"ping")
    got = sb.recv(100)
    assert got == b"ping"
    assert (sa.send_ops, sa.send_bytes) == (1, 4)
    assert (sb.recv_ops, sb.recv_bytes) == (1, 4)
print("smoke test OK")
EOF

import socket, tempfile, os
from paasio import MeteredFile, MeteredSocket

with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) as t:
    t.write(b"hello world")
    t.flush()
    path = t.name
try:
    with MeteredFile(open(path, "r+b")) as f:
        n = f.write(b"hello world")
        f.seek(0)
        data = f.read()
    assert (n, data, f.write_ops, f.write_bytes, f.read_ops, f.read_bytes) == (11, b"hello world", 1, 11, 1, 11)
    with MeteredFile(open(path, "r+b")) as f:
        lines = list(f)
    assert lines == [b"hello world"], lines
    assert (f.read_ops, f.read_bytes) == (2, 11)  # 2nd readline hits EOF
finally:
    os.unlink(path)

a, b = socket.socketpair()
with MeteredSocket(a) as sa, MeteredSocket(b) as sb:
    sa.send(b"ping")
    got = sb.recv(100)
    assert got == b"ping"
    assert (sa.send_ops, sa.send_bytes) == (1, 4)
    assert (sb.recv_ops, sb.recv_bytes) == (1, 4)
    sa.send(b"ping", 0)
    assert sb.recv(100, 0) == b"ping"  # flags passthrough
print("smoke test OK")
EOF
